lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Welcome to Sweets & Cocoa!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Gah! That guy appeared out of nowhere!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ... ※▣□A hologram?
Who are you?
The way this guy looks and talks... could it be...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: That's right, it's me!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I'm the AI manager of the community-based chocolate factory on the surface, Sweets & Cocoa. The one and only Sweet Johnny!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Aren't you curious as to how I ended up here at the Ark?
... How did you end up here?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I said, aren't you curious as to...
Fine. How did you end up here?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: it's a rather long story, you see.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Where should I start?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Many millennia ago, when life first appeared on our planet...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What the...?! How far back are you going to go?!
Make it short and give us a summary.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Well, basically, I was really lone...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Er... I mean, it has to do with fulfilling my intended purpose.
And what is that?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Shouldn't that be obvious?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Valentine's Day is a day where a young girl's romantic dreams can come alive!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: How could a day like that proceed without me?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Helping make these lovely ladies' romantic aspirations become a reality is my sacred duty.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: It's definitely not because you promised to return and completely failed to show up!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: You sure talk a lot.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Master Captain, do you and this guy have a history?
I'm not sure...
I think so.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: The past is of little importance!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: What's important is what path forward we choose.
So, what are you planning to do moving forward?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Another question with an obvious answer.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Going forward, I...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Going forward... Go-going...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: What's going on? Why is it doing this?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □※▣Are you broken or※▣something? Or too old?※

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □□※※I thought you said you were an※▣AI from the surface.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Time has no effect on an exceptional AI like me!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: So... Uh...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I suppose I'm broken.
You're telling me you came in through this?
I gesture to the phone on the table.
A faint blue light flickers from the screen which projects Johnny's hologram.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Not long after you left, those young girls...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I mean, Nikkes, visited our factory.
They must have been part of a resource-gathering squad.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I believe that was the term they used to describe themselves, yes.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Anyway, I learned a lot from their stories.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: When I supplemented that with what you told me during your visit,

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I learned that humanity lost the war and fled underground, where they remain trapped.
That's exactly what happened.
In order to reclaim the surface, we...

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: That's of no importance to me.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Those Nikkes aren't much different from the young girls I once knew.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: It's simply that instead of pretty clothes, they wear combat gear.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Instead of phones, they carry guns.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Instead of hanging out with friends or going on dates, they fight those things called Raptures.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: That's true, but it's not like it's super difficult or anything.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Yeah, not when we've got Master with us.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: That's wonderful to hear.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: However... I still want to help.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I want to let you know that, on the most beautiful day which is Valentine's Day,

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: all of your romantic dreams can come true, even if just a little.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ※▣▣But you lost□a lot of information□during the▣※▣data transmission?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: That's right, little lady.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: The vast knowledge that once filled my core,

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: the sense of romance that once stirred within my heart,

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I can't feel any of it now!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Without that, I'm merely a piece of AI, albeit an extremely sophisticated one.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: This guy reminds me of Mast.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What? How does he remind you of me?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □▣The overflowing※▣confidence?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: ... Is that how I come off?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: All done.
Trony unplugs the cable connected to the phone.
What shape is it in?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: This isn't exactly my area of expertise,

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: but I'm pretty sure I can fix it.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Sorry for startling you.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: But please understand, little lady. Everything depends on you.
Did the data get corrupted?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: To put it simply, yes.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: The transmission line was less than ideal,

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: so the data got distorted.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Ironically though, that's precisely what allowed it to fit into a small device like this phone.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: If I analyze the data patterns, move it to a proper device, and restore it...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I think about 97% of what's in here should be recoverable.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Thank you! Truly.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: The only thing is...

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: What's recoverable is the personality data and the main computation system.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: The vast amount of data you were talking about never got transmitted in the first place.
I figured as much.
Transferring such colossal amounts of data isn't easy, even for an advanced AI.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: I can't believe this!
Johnny. That factory is still intact, isn't it?
I suppose we could consider that the body that houses you, in a way.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Are you saying that...
I'll help you.
Trony, what would happen if you were able to transfer the data from there?

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: I would be able to restore 100% of the data, no problem.
Good. The factory isn't that far, so let's go.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: You're actually going to help this guy?
... There might be some useful information contained in there.
At the very least, there might be a nice chocolate recipe or something.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Forget chocolate! What you'll find in abundance is adventure!
Don't get too excited. It's just an abandoned factory.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: You're incredible, Master Captain.
Hmm?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Nothing, it's just...

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I was thinking about how this is very much like you.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Anyway, we should get going. I'll come with you.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I want to go too.
All right. Trony, you get ready for the data transfer.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Just a minute.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: If you're not going to bring back the entire framework, we'll need some spare parts too.
Johnny, would we be able to find those inside the factory?

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Maintenance is the hallmark of a gentleman.

lines.speaker: sweetjohnny
lines.text: Over the years, I've used all manner of objects for self-repair.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Uh... That's not exactly a good thing.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: The AI system is very outdated. It might not be implementable with modern parts.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □※※□I should be able to take care of▣▣that.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: ▣※I'll ask▣some of my connections.※▣They'll find□□something that'll work.※▣
Thanks.
Sounds like you're finding this quite enjoyable.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Yeah,□※▣it's really fun.
... Okay. Thanks.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: All right! My first raid as an official pirate!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Going in search of hidden adventure in an abandoned factory!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Wow, just thinking about it is enough to fill my heart to bursting!
... Let's hurry. We'll be back, Trony.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: □See you▣soon.
Mast, Anchor, and I leave the store.
We have to stop by the Outpost first, but if we hurry, we should be able to make it back by tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Master.
Yes?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: This Johnny guy.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Is there a glitch in his personality?
Uh...
Must be.
I think he's always been like this.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I see.
